event.title: Hungary Faces Severe Water Crisis as Drought Drains Lakes and Rivers
event.canonical_title: Hungary Faces Severe Water Crisis as Drought Drains Lakes and Rivers
event.summary: Hungary is experiencing a significant water crisis due to prolonged heat and drought conditions. Approximately 99% of the country is under severe or extreme drought, leading to record low water levels in lakes and rivers. The Great Hungarian Plain is particularly threatened by desertification.
